title: Playing outside the city
summary: He played Jefferson and St. Charles Parishes and Mississippi but rarely left the state, partly due to his day job.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Did you travel much? No. You never did get, did you play up in, uh, Jefferson Parish, or?
Yeah, I played Jefferson Parish. St. Charles. I went around in the... stuff

Oh, you did go out state? Yeah, Mississippi a couple of times. Texas? Yeah. I didn't, I never went to Texas, no. Hardly ever went out of state, though. How did you get a job out of town? Well, now, somebody from in town would know somebody in the place, and they inquire about a band, and you get in contact with them, then they get the arrangement needed for you. Oh, I see. Yeah. That's the way it was done.
But you couldn't go really because you were working a day job.
Working a day, there was always somebody who wouldn't go, but some of these people who
wasn't working, they needed the job so bad they'd go anywhere. And they'd get somebody in the place.
Yeah, that's right. They'd go by my place. And I didn't mind.
